about_item: Orthopedic Support with Enhanced Comfort: This thickened dog bed utilizes double shredded foam and a 2:1 polyester blend, delivering twice the thickness of typical beds. It effectively balances cushioning and support to ease pressure on joints and the spine, suitable for pets of all sizes.

Headrest Design for Added Relief: Featuring a 3-sided headrest with supportive bolsters, this bed offers extra comfort for your pet’s neck and head. The lowered front allows easy access, reducing strain and helping pets of all ages rest comfortably.

Soft, Warm Surface with Stylish Quilting: Crafted with a plush rabbit fur and chenille top, the bed provides gentle warmth and a cozy sleeping surface. Its quilted pattern adds a subtle decorative touch to complement your home.

Convenient Care & Waterproof Protection: Designed with a removable, machine-washable cover featuring discreet zippers. The waterproof layer helps guard against spills and moisture, simplifying cleanup and maintaining hygiene.

Secure Materials & Stable Design: Made with pet-safe materials, including an OEKO-TEX (21.HCN.88663) certified cover, for comfort and peace of mind. The non-slip bottom ensures stability on various floor types.
